test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

POTENT
solution: The correct answer is '**powerful**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Potent**' is '**Powerful**'. • **Potent**: strong or powerful. (शक्तिशाली या प्रभावकारी) • *Example: Their most **potent** weapon was the Exocet missile.* • **Powerful**: having a lot of control or influence over other people. (शक्तिशाली, प्रभावशाली, असरदार) • *Example: He is a **powerful** leader.* **Correct Answer:**__ *powerful.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Beautiful**: very pretty or attractive; giving pleasure to the senses. (सुंदर, ख़ूबसूरत, आकर्षक; रमणीय, प्रियकर) • **Graceful**: having a smooth, attractive movement or form. (लालित्‍यपूर्ण, मनोहारी) • **Wonderful**: extremely good; fantastic. (अत्‍युत्तम, बहुत बढ़िया; आश्‍चर्यजनक, अद्‌भुत) 3b:Tc12, The correct answer is '**simple**'.
